method: Official wong.pe 'Nuestras Tiendas' page (/stores, VTEX IO custom component wongio.wongiocompo1app Mystore) loads https://www.wong.pe/files/store.json (22 entries incl. 'Spid Pardo' and inactive 'Wong Panorama'). Cross-checked with the public VTEX checkout API /api/checkout/pub/pickup-points swept around 48 Peruvian city centres (1 req/s): each Wong store is a seller 'wongio<code>wio' with a 'Retiro en Sucursal' pickup point (codes T1xx/TH12) carrying geoCoordinates; 24 found. Final list = 21: the 20 active store.json Wong stores + T127 Wong El Golf (Trujillo; announced as the 21st Wong for 1H2026, active seller, opening not confirmed by press - verify). Coordinates from the seller pickup points (store.json coords were not used; e.g. Wong Aldabas store.json coords point to Miraflores, 4.1 km off). Excluded: T131 Wong Panorama (closed 2025-03-18 per Diario Financiero; store.json active=false), T134 'Wong Primavera' (Av. Primavera 2205, Surco - matches the The Square community center, opening scheduled Nov 2026 per Infobae 2026-05-22), T135 'Wong Marina' (Av. Rafael Escardó 530, San Miguel - Marina City Center, opening 4Q2026 per Infobae), and 'Spid Pardo' (Av. José Pardo 575, Miraflores - Spid is a different Cencosud banner). Reported count: 20 (peru-retail, May 2026); Gestión (2026-02-18) said El Golf would make 21; Cencosud corporate presentation (May 2026) shows 88 supermarkets in Peru for Wong+Metro combined.
